title: mise rc config
description: Early initialization settings for mise. These settings are loaded before the main config files.

ceiling_paths.description: Directories where mise stops searching parent directories for config files.

env.description: Config environments to load, such as `development` for `mise.development.toml`.

env_conf_d.description: Enable environment-specific filenames in conf.d directories.

ignored_config_paths.description: Config files and directories mise does not load.

override_config_filenames.description: Project config filenames that mise looks for instead of `mise.toml`, `.mise.toml` and the other standard names.

override_tool_versions_filenames.description: Filenames that mise reads as `.tool-versions` files instead of `.tool-versions`.
